decisions.reason: As a close-to-core supplement line with several variants, its continued presence suggests results at least near aspiration, and the firm's slack makes retention the likely choice.
This consumer-health supplement had a clear launch push and, having remained in the portfolio, would likely be judged as performing acceptably relative to aspiration.
Its lower visibility makes it somewhat more vulnerable, but it fits existing capabilities and is inexpensive to carry, so management would usually keep it absent a clear shortfall.
The niche positioning raises uncertainty, yet it remains close to the established offer and organizational slack supports keeping such a product while learning continues.
Although more distant from the core and therefore held to a tougher aspiration benchmark, it still fits the firm's portfolio-broadening path and would more likely be continued than dropped this year.
